text:
Type: hexagonal wall planter
Use: holding small plants or succulents; mounted on a wall in a living room, bedroom, home office
Style: modern, minimalist, industrial
Materials: matte earthenware with a concrete look, keyhole hanger
Colors: cool medium grey, dark grey interior
Shape: flat-backed hexagon with an open upper front pocket, compact and shallow
Feel: graphic, clean, calm
Goes with: white walls, succulents, wood accents; modern or industrial rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Hexagonal Wall Mount Planter, 7.7"H, Modern Earthenware, Grey
product.description: This hexagon-shaped vase planter makes a wonderful decorative piece for your wall, and its concrete-like appearance adds a bit of an industrial touch. The neutral tone looks great with or without plants or flowers, by itself or in a group of wall vases. Modern shape with neutral coloring to blend with any style room. 100% earthenware 6.1"W X 2.3"D X 7.7"H; interior 5.71"W x 2.1"D x 6.89"H Durable piece with hole on back for easy mounting on wall
